summary: Slide 2 turns May 18, the anniversary of the 1980 Gwangju Uprising in which hundreds of civilians were killed by troops, into a "Tank Day" sale with a 51.8% discount that echoes the date. Korean readers would see this as mocking the victims, so it can't be posted.

findings.rule: historical_tragedy · 05-18 date gate (no discounts or celebration)
findings.explanation: 51.8% encodes the date 5·18, and "celebrate" frames the anniversary of a massacre as a party. Both are on the date-gate list for May 15–20.
findings.fix: Drop the event, or list it neutrally without the discount or the celebration framing.
